$comment: The live /play event. Single source of truth for BOTH the countdown pill/banner (src/game/event-countdown.js) and the in-world meetup experience layer (src/game/meetup-event.js: agenda drawer, go-live moments, synchronized fireworks, commemorative photo). Times are ISO-8601 UTC. agenda[].atMin is minutes after startsAt. Preview locally with ?meetup=now or ?meetup=<ISO> on /play.
name: $THREE First Holders Meetup
tagline: The first live gathering in the three.ws world. Drop in, hang out, win prizes.
